My first pass treated game 8 as having only one turn and scored it 30, so game 7 (56) won match 4 for Player 1.

With turn 15 restored, all 6,000 turns form 3,000 complete two-turn games. Game 8 now scores 70 (its turn 15 scores 48 in the Highs and Lows category — max 6 × min 2 × difference 4 — combined with turn 16's Summation of 22, using distinct categories), so game 8 beats game 7's 56 and match 4 flips to Player 2. That's exactly the 2-match swing the verifier flagged.

Final tally across the 1,500 matches: Player 1 (odd games) won 739, Player 2 (even games) won 716, 45 tied → 739 − 716 = **23**.
